name: Stillwater
known_age: Approximately 30–40 years active in GLMZ. Younger than Covenant and Registry by all observable measures — fewer chips, damage patterns that suggest fewer decades of proximity to hard things. Arrived in the lower residential tiers without prior documentation of their presence elsewhere.
crack_pattern: Three clean, precise cracks on the right side of the face, parallel and evenly spaced, running from the jaw to the cheekbone. They look deliberate — too clean for accident, too even for impact. Whether they were made intentionally or whether a single incident produced this pattern is not known. Stillwater has not addressed the question. A faint network of fine stress-lines around the left eye socket that do not appear to be worsening.
current_role: Violence broker and pre-conflict settlement specialist for the lower residential tiers and the Outer Industrial Belt fringe. Stillwater's function is not mediation after conflict but the interception of conflict before the first body. They specialize in the period — sometimes hours, sometimes days — when violence has been decided but not yet executed, and they insert themselves into that gap.
known_location: No fixed address. Stillwater appears. People who need to find them seem to be able to find them, by means that are not entirely clear. People who want to hire someone to find them on their behalf have consistently reported that the intermediary found Stillwater, but also that Stillwater had already known they were coming and had a position ready.
diplomatic_specialty: Pre-conflict intervention in the lower residential tiers and industrial fringe. Stillwater works with a faster clock than Covenant — their negotiations are measured in hours and the stakes are immediate. Gang territory, crew disputes, the moment after an insult that can't be taken back. They appear before the first shot with a proposal that everyone in the room knows they should take, and they wait, in the specific patient way of the Ceramic Men, for the room to decide that shooting is less interesting than the proposal.
operating_history: Roughly three decades in the lower tiers. In that time, the residential areas where Stillwater operates have a statistically anomalous rate of conflict resolution without casualties compared to neighboring areas — a discrepancy that no corponation security analyst has publicly explained because the explanation requires acknowledging Stillwater's existence and the corponations prefer the narrative that their own security operations are responsible. Stillwater has never corrected this record. They seem uninterested in credit.
behavioral_notes: The fastest-speaking Ceramic Man observed. Where Covenant uses silence and Registry uses economy, Stillwater talks — not voluminously, but quickly and precisely, reading the room with a velocity that suggests either long experience with the specific emotional dynamics of imminent violence or something else. They know who in a room is closest to acting. They speak to that person first. They do not argue and they do not persuade in the conventional sense; they present an alternative outcome with such clinical clarity that violence starts to feel like extra work. Their fee is information, as always. They ask their one question after the parties have separated, when the adrenaline has not yet resolved, which is when people are most likely to answer honestly.
known_associations: At least seven active crew leaders in the lower residential tiers — not as allies but as a standing resource
The Outer Industrial Belt Freeholders Compact — informal mediation relationship
Several factions with active territorial disputes, none of whom know Stillwater is also working with their counterpart
damage_history: The three parallel cracks have been present since Stillwater's first documented appearance in the lower tiers. No one has ever seen them without the cracks, which means whatever made them happened before they arrived here, or before anyone who is now alive was watching. The stress lines around the left eye are newer — they were not present in documentation from ten years ago and are. They have been asked about this. They said they had been somewhere difficult recently. They did not say where.
story_hooks: Stillwater appears in a runner's safe house the evening before a job that the runner has not told anyone about. Stillwater says there is a conflict the runner is about to create without intending to, and offers a settlement. The settlement requires the runner to not take the job.

Two crews have been building toward war for weeks. Stillwater has been working both sides independently. Something has changed — Stillwater has stopped showing up to one side's meetings. The other side is not sure what this means but they're fairly sure it means something.

A runner is hired to find out who Stillwater reports to — who gets the information from all those single questions. The investigation leads somewhere that makes the original question feel much less important than it did.
